what: From the moment the panel center reaches the screen center until the top edge of the text range touches the top of the screen, the 26px frame margin on all sides of the pinned big photo panel retracts to 0 (straight) and brightness drops from 100% to 40% (power1.out). The poem lines flowing over it rise from 50px below while passing between 10% and 30% from the screen bottom. The stacked photos split the text range into photo count minus 1 segments, and in each segment the next photo floats up over the previous one. All of it is tied to scroll.

options.inset: Initial frame inset (px), default 26 — the pre-script shape is --fx-inset (css)
options.y: Distance the post rows float up (px), default 50
options.ease: Brightness and photo overlap curve, default power1.out
options.[data-fx-part=stage] > [data-fx-part=fra: Panel pinned to the screen · frame that peels away · stacked photos (first one at the start)
options.[data-fx-part=track]: Text span continuing behind the board — flows over the board and sets the length of the photo-change segment
